correctness.rationale: After any positive number of draws at most two coupons can remain unseen. For any k≥1, the probability of one specified missing coupon is q^k and the probability of two specified missing coupons is p_ij^k, giving exactly nq^k−Σp_ij^k. Strict Jensen minimizes the pair power sum uniquely at uniform for k≥2. After scaling by q, independent positive-support incidence columns characterize vertices of the row-sum-one polytope. A support leaf forces a unit isolated edge; otherwise, the number of edges is both at least the vertex count by minimum degree and at most that count by column independence. Hence the remaining components are cycles, necessarily odd and half-weighted. Strict convexity forces every maximum of the power sum to be a vertex. If r vertices lie in odd cycles its value is n/2−r(1/2−2^(−k)), strictly decreasing in r. The smallest r is zero for even n and three for odd n, with exactly the stated supports. k=1 gives tail 1 regardless of p; the means include the k=0 tail 1 and follow by geometric summation, with strictness inherited from k=2. Exact-rational independent checks of n=4 through 8, including direct omission-sequence enumeration for horizons at most 3, agree. evidence: By the factorial moment formula, E W_k=nq^k and E(W_k)_2=2Σp_ij^k. The rank-2 equality condition reduces to p_ij constant. This gives the exact upper tail and equality directly.

Every vertex of the same F_n has coordinates in {0,1/2,1} and Σ w_e=n/2. For k≥2 let a_k=2−2^(2−k)>0. On those three possible weights, x^k=a_k x²+(1−a_k)x. Thus on vertices Σw_e^k=a_kΣw_e²+(1−a_k)n/2. For every k≥2, strict convexity of Σw_e^k rules out a nonvertex maximizer, so the exact 71ae72613d53 optimizer classification transfers unchanged, including matching plus triangle for every odd n. Substitution gives both lower-tail formulas; summing gives the exact means.

originality.rationale: The full sandwich with equality is recoverable from verified existing exact results, including the odd case. An indexed coupon-moment theorem gives the very survival reduction and its unique uniform upper extremum in the two-omission model. An earlier indexed geometric result treats the identical fractional matching polytope, classifies all its vertices, and gives precisely the parity extremizers of the square objective. On those vertices, every k-power sum is a strictly increasing affine function of the square sum (shown below), so strict convexity transfers exactly that classification to all horizons. This is an implication assessment, not a claim of copied work or publication priority.
residual_risks: Schilling's full text was not retrieved. No whole-document coverage or absence conclusion is made for that source.

The direct even-n manuscript and rank-2 record are later-dated. The verified implications and earlier polytope overlap settle coverage at review time, not attribution or historical priority for the complete coupon theorem.
